meta.title: A bid exactly at the price cap is accepted
gaps: UI-FCOL-002 is not defined as a setup recipe.
The value of X was unspecified, so 100 was used for both the cap and the bid.
The available operation semantics state that a bid must be strictly below the price cap, so acceptance conflicts with the defined behavior.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sets the invited vendor's price cap on the round to 100 (a bid must be strictly below it) for the invited QA vendor.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts the new bid.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the round counts the new bid.

plan.title: A bid exactly at the price cap is accepted

assert.say: the round counts the new bid
